newsitem.title: FINLAND: SISU SAYS STATE TO BUY ITS MILITARY VEHICLE UNIT.
newsitem.headline: SISU SAYS STATE TO BUY ITS MILITARY VEHICLE UNIT.

text.p: Finnish state-owned heavy vehicle maker Oy Sisu Ab said on Wednesday the Finnish state will buy its military vehicle unit with the intention to merge it with the state-run defence equipment company to be established.

"The entire share capital of Sisu Defence Oy will be acquired by the State of Finland, whith an intention of a future merger with the defence equipment company which is currently being estanblished by the Finnish government," Sisu said in a statement.
The arrangement is planned to be completed by the end of this year.

Sisu Defence's 1995 net sales were 260 million markka, up from 225 million in 1994, and the unit has 192 employees, Sisu said. Sisu group's 1995 net sales were 5.9 billion markka, up from 4.6 billion in 1994.
The main products of Sisu Defence are armored carriers (Pasi), rubber-tracked all-terrain vehicles (Nasu), and mine-clearing vehicles (Raisu), Sisu said.
